description: List changes to published rules, oldest first: new versions, amendments, corrections and repeals, each naming the rule, the versions moved from and to, the effective date and the version id to pass to resolve_version. Example: `{"since": "2026-10-01", "jurisdictions": ["us", "us-wa"]}`. Each jurisdiction matches its own rules only, so for everything that changes Washington's answer pass the federal level too. While `has_more` is true, call again with the response's `cursor`. Needs an API key whose plan includes the change feed; otherwise the error says so. Informational only, not legal advice.

cursor.description: The `cursor` of the previous response, to continue or to poll for new changes.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdiction slugs, e.g. `["us", "us-wa"]`; each matches its own rules only.

since.description: Where to start: an ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. `2026-10-01` (midnight UTC). Give this or `cursor`.

name: list_changes
title: List rule changes
